text: Brew Lab, Indiranagar, Bengaluru. One-page site. Must-haves, each one will be checked: today's opening hours are highlighted automatically; the pre-order form shows a running total in rupees; the loyalty section shows 10 stamp circles with the 10th marked FREE; every menu item shows a price; the location section has a "Get directions" link; the page works at 360px wide.

@Requester Not enough to write a checkable charter yet. The brief gives the six must-haves but not the content facts they depend on. I need four things from you.
1. What are the opening hours for each day of the week, including any closed days?
2. List every menu item with its price in rupees, grouped by category if you have them. Should the pre-order form offer all of these items?
   Option 1: Yes, all menu items
   Option 2: Only some (please say which)
3. What is the full street address of Brew Lab, or a Google Maps link, to use for the "Get directions" link?
4. What should the pre-order form do on submit, and what details should it collect?
   Option 1: Name and pickup time, then show a confirmation message on the page
   Option 2: Name, phone and pickup time, then open WhatsApp with the order
   Option 3: Name, phone and pickup time, then send by email
   Option 4: Something else (please describe)
Paused: Identity is waiting on the Requester (J2.a: not enough information to work yet). Site v0 is in the preview. Answer Identity's question above to continue.

1. Hours: Monday to Friday 8am to 10pm, Saturday and Sunday 9am to 11pm. No closed days.

2. Menu (prices in ₹):
Coffee: Espresso 120, Cappuccino 180, Pour-over 220
Cold: Cold brew 200
Food: Croissant 150, Banana bread 130
Option 1: yes, all menu items can be pre-ordered.

3. Address: 100 Feet Road, Indiranagar, Bengaluru 560038.
Google Maps link: https://maps.google.com/?q=100+Feet+Road+Indiranagar+Bengaluru+560038

4. Option 2: name, phone and pickup time (within opening hours), then open WhatsApp +91 98450 00000 with the order. Show a running total in ₹. Pay at pickup.
The 10th loyalty stamp gives one free drink of any size.
